package.name: nidar_map2d
package.description: Live 2D map and survivor tagging for NIDAR (Phase 5): map_2d_slicer.py slices FUEL's occupancy into a nav_msgs/OccupancyGrid on /map_2d, grid_visualizer.py publishes the A1..G7 grid overlay and the per-survivor cell tags. view_map2d.sh opens the RViz layout live or against a recorded bag.
